title: Whodunnit: The Late-Night Heist
story: On a dimly lit corner of the city, Detective John was investigating a series of baffling robberies. The latest target was a high-security vault at the prestigious Diamond Dynasty jewelry store. The alarm was triggered at 11:55 pm, and the only eyewitness, Mrs. Smith, confirmed seeing a hooded figure leaving the scene at 11:53 pm.
victim: Victim: The owner of Diamond Dynasty, Mr. Singh.
crimeScene: Setting: Diamond Dynasty jewelry store, dimly lit, 11:55 pm.
forensicClue: Forensic Evidence: A distinctive shoe imprint left behind with a size 10
question: Who pulled off the heist and what was their motive?
options: Option A: Suspect 1 (Motive: Mercenary, Alibi: Reliable dinner party at 9 pm)
Option B: Suspect 2 (Motive: Family feud, Alibi: Movie marathon at home)
Option C: Suspect 3 (Motive: Jealousy, Alibi: Late-night jog)
Option D: Suspect 4 (Motive: Ambition, Alibi: Research at the library from 9 pm to midnight)
